title: Using data-driven algorithms for semi-automated geomorphological mapping.
summary: Springer PDF Methods/Results: Direct Sampling and Random Forest trained using a manually mapped area and evaluated over the adjacent Arolla valley test area against a field-made map of eight classes. Both had similar accuracy/Kappa; DS yielded less spatially noisy classes by accounting for spatial dependence. This is a bounded new geomorphology mapping application. The admission is restricted to this measured result and study setting; it is not evidence of deployment benefit.
